items.title: FlashFry
items.description: [software] - A command line tool for high-throughput design and screening of Cas9,Cas12a/Cpf1 and other CRISPR targets, with a focus on speed. Many design metrics are available, including common on and off-target scores.

items.title: DeepCRISPR
items.description: [Python, webserver] - A deep learning based prediction model for sgRNA on-target knockout efficacy and genome-wide off-target cleavage profile prediction.

items.title: CLD
items.description: [software] - CRISPR library designer (CLD), a software for multispecies design of single guide RNA libraries

items.title: Crisflash
items.description: [software] - A software to generate CRISPR guide RNAs against genomes annotated with individual variation.

items.title: CRISPR Library Designer
items.description: [software] - A software for the multispecies design of sgRNA libraries.

items.title: beditor
items.description: [python] - A Computational Workflow for Designing Libraries of sgRNAs for CRISPR-Mediated Base Editing.

items.title: Crackling
items.description: [software] - Crackling is a standalone pipeline that combines multiple scoring approaches and constant-time search algorithms to select safe and efficient CRISPR-Cas9 guide RNA from whole genomes

items.title: pgRNAFinder
items.description: [python]- A web-based tool to design distance independent paired-gRNA
All-in-one platforms for planning, simulating and documenting cloning and genome engineering workflows, including CRISPR-based strain construction.

items.title: pydna
items.description: [python] - A Python library to simulate and document reproducible cloning strategies, including CRISPR-Cas9 cut simulation and CRISPR-mediated engineering. BMC Bioinfo

items.title: OpenCloning
items.description: [webserver] - An open-source web application to plan and document cloning and genome engineering, including CRISPR-based strain engineering. code

items.title: Cloning and strain engineering
CRISPRme
items.description: [webserver] - CRISPRme is a tool for comprehensive off-target assessment that considers effects of human genetic variants. code Recommended

items.title: GT-Scan2
items.description: [R] - It is Chromatin- and Transcription-aware target site optimization tool for CRISPR/CAS9.

items.title: CRIS.py
items.description: [Python] - A versatile and high-throughput analysis program for CRISPR-based genome editing.

items.title: CrispRVariants
items.description: [R] - A R-based toolkit for counting, localizing and plotting targeted insertion and deletion variant combinations from CRISPR-Cas9 mutagenesis experiments.

items.title: CRISPR-DAV
items.description: [Perl, R] - A CRISPR NGS data analysis and visualization pipeline.

items.title: crispr-DART
items.description: [Python, R] - A workflow to analyze CRISPR-Cas-induced indel mutations in targeted/amplicon DNA sequencing. Can work with single/multiplexed sgRNAs per region(s).

items.title: CRISPRmatch
items.description: [Python] - An automatic calculation and visualization tool for high-throughput CRISPR genome-editing data analysis.

items.title: AmpliconDIVider
items.description: [Perl] - AmpliconDIVider contains the scripts used to identify deletion and insertion variants (DIVs) in DNA amplicons.

items.title: BATCH-GE
items.description: [Perl] - A batch analysis of Next-Generation Sequencing data for genome editing assessment.

items.title: ScreenProcessing
items.description: [Python] - A complete pipeline for processing data generated by the genome-scale CRISPR screen platform developed at the Weissman Lab. It offers key features and careful implementation in comparison to MAGeCK. Paper: eLife 2016

items.title: ScreenPro2
items.description: [Python] – Flexible analysis of high-content CRISPR screening. Recommended

items.title: DrugZ
items.description: [python] - DrugZ is a software that detects synergistic and suppressor drug-gene interactions in CRISPR screens. Paper: Genome Medicine 2019.

items.title: CaRpools
items.description: [R] - A pipeline for end-to-end analysis of pooled CRISPR/Cas9 screening data. Including in-depth analysis of screening quality and sgRNA phenotypes.

items.title: Normalisr
items.description: [Python, Shell] - Single-cell CRISPR screen (e.g. Perturb-seq, CROP-seq) analysis for robust, efficient gene differential expression and regulatory network reconstruction with accurate FDR control. Paper: Nature Communications 2021.

items.title: CRISPR-SURF
items.description: [webserver] - A computational framework to discover regulatory elements by deconvolution of CRISPR tiling screen data.

items.title: JACKS
items.description: [Python] - A Bayesian method that jointly analyses screens performed with the same guide RNA library.

items.title: CRISPhieRmix
items.description: [R] - A hierarchical mixture model for CRISPR pooled screens

items.title: ScreenBEAM
items.description: [R] - Gene-level meta-analysis of high-throughput functional genomics (RNAi or CRISPR) screens.

items.title: MAUDE
items.description: [R] - An R package for analyzing sorting-based (e.g FACS) CRISPR screens and other high-throughput screens with a sorting readout.

items.title: MinCED
items.description: [Java] - A program to find Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPRs) in full genomes or environmental datasets such as assembled contigs from metagenomes.

items.title: CRISPRdisco
items.description: [software] - Identifying CRISPR repeat-spacer arrays and cas genes in genome data sets.

items.title: MetaCRAST
items.description: [software] - A tool detects CRISPR arrays in raw, unassembled metagenomes.
